status_sentence: RH unproved; structural refinements and consistency tests; no new independent positivity theorem.

certificate_rule.positive_galerkin_minimum: upper bound on that matrix, not a certificate of positivity, and not a controlled limit in the basis size
certificate_rule.negative_explicit_vector: strong numerical witness inside the arithmetic and quadrature error of the run; certified only if a rigorous error bound is attached

window_convention.A: full width of the interval [-A/2, A/2] in the spring and signature scripts

not_run.trace_norm_leakage_S_infinity_and_2: Ill-posed as drafted. A trace norm is nonnegative, so leakage cannot be assigned a negative sign. A future test must bound the nonnegative norm and, separately, a signed quadratic remainder, and only then discuss decay.

corrections_applied_on_top_of_the_bundle: Status is not 'nothing claims progress.' The night contributes a sharper target and consistency tests, and no new positivity theorem.

The spring target is global domination E_springs >= M||F||^2. Near cancellation is the diagnostic. Prime spring energy is always >= 0. The net prime term after the counterterm is signed with the autocorrelation.
E0 is dense in L2 and not closed. The fixed-window kernel is closed of codimension 2. Smooth E0 is not an L2-closed set.
Finite-field samples are not continuous Mellin moments.
There is no universal identity 'every mechanism is a square plus an indefinite boundary.'
Connes 1999 projection order is characteristic p. The number-field comparison is equivalent to RH. Subtraction is not automatically positive.
II_{1,1} is an analogy. No arithmetic lattice is constructed.
Kähler anti-self-dual geometry and the finite-field Hodge index are different theorems.
The sought arithmetic correspondence geometry is not built. Do not say the Connes-Consani square of sites does not exist.
Norm identity, semidefinite quotient allowed, is Weil positivity hence RH. The four construction criteria are not automatic consequences of RH.
Place-local squares cannot match signed local terms one place at a time. A global coupled use of primes, Euler factors, and gamma data is allowed.
Neither a positive representation nor G0 selects W.
Trace-norm leakage is nonnegative.
Only-Hodge-as-sign-source is false.
Torsion signs are convention-dependent.
Lambda(1/2-it)/Lambda(1/2+it) = 1 by the functional equation. No group-delay positivity.
Vacuum density proportional to |Lambda|^2 is omitted.
Theta sign-change at zeros is omitted.
h = -1 Virasoro norm is algebra, not a unitarity proof. Central charge is not a speed and not a topological charge.
Semilocal Sonin is one candidate, not the unique arithmetic energy condition.
Q0 and D commute on the core with G0. Fixed-window self-adjointness needs boundary conditions. Real F gives a self-adjoint convolution only if F sharp equals F. Translations are abelian.
